On 29 November 2021, soldiers foiled an attempt by IPOB militants to abduct some medical doctors and nurses and pursued the militants to Amauju (Isu, Imo), coded as Umundugba, where they clashed. One militant was killed, one other was arrested with gunshot wounds.

On 29 November 2021, troops of security forces on patrol clashed with members of a Kaduna militia at an identified hideout in Idasu (Giwa, Kaduna) and Birnin Gwari [coded separately]. Three militia members were killed, weapons and three motorcycles were recovered.

On 29 November 2021, a member of the Eiye cult militia attacked some hotel lodgers at Obantoko, Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The police responded to a distress call from the hotel, and he was arrested with a locally-fabricated double-barrelled shotgun with one expended cartridge.

On 29 November 2021, police forces repelled an attack by Yansakai militia on the Fulani settlement in Bargaja (Gusau, Zamfara). Three civilians were killed by the militia before the arrival of the police.
On 29 November 2021, military forces repelled an attack by ISWAP militants on Auno (Konduga, Borno). Causalities unknown.

On 29 November 2021, police forces intercepted and clashed with suspected Boko Haram militants who abducted travelers around the Yanakiri/Kondori village (Nganzai, Borno). 16 travelers, including an off duty soldier, were rescued, three travelers are still missing; Casualties are unknown.

On 29 November 2021, presumed Boko haram/ ISWAP militants ambushed commuters along Auno-Mainok road (Kaga, Borno) and abducted at least eight people. Security forces imposed a restriction on movement in the area due to the heightened presence of the militants.
On 29 November 2021, a Zamfara militia clashed with a Karazau militia when they returned to attack Karazau community (Gusau, Zamfara) for a third time. Causalities unknown.

On 29 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked a Fulani settlement in Barakallahu community at Igabi (Igabi, Kaduna). One person was killed, an undisclosed number of cows were stolen by the assailants.
On 30 November 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked a Fulani settlement in Ligari village (Chikun, Kaduna) and shot sporadically before they abducted one person and rustled many cows.

On 30 November 2021, at least 10 persons were killed and scores went missing in reprisal attacks by Fulani militias on Tiv villagers within the Bantaje Chiefdom in Gassol LGA (Taraba). According to the leader of the Bantaje Chiefdom, six other farmers were killed at the boundary between Gassol and Wukari LGAs. The attacks are believed to be a reprisal for the killing of a Fulani man after he was robbed by a tiv man.

Around 30 November 2021, (between 22 November- 30 November), a supremacy battle between the Black Axe and Eiye cult militias left six people dead in Okitipupa (Okitipupa, Ondo). Ten other militiamen were injured in the clash, which prompted the local government and other stakeholders to impose a curfew on the community (coded separately). 6 fatalities reported.

On 30 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants, enforcing a sit at home order, clashed with soldiers in Akata (Oru, Imo) and Mgbidi [coded separately]. The soldiers were deployed to contain the militants, casualties are unknown.

On 30 November 2021, suspected IPOB militants, enforcing a sit at home order, clashed with soldiers in Mgbidi (Oru West, Imo) and Akata [coded separately]. The soldiers were deployed to contain the militants, casualties are unknown.

On 30 November 2021, Nigerian troops, supported by the air force, and police repelled an attempt by ISWAP militants to infiltrate Buni Yadi (Gujba, Yobe) using gun trucks which were destroyed and some seized, while the militants fled after several others were killed. ISWAP claimed the attack and killing and injuring several soldiers. Fatalities coded as 10.
On 1 October 2021, IPOB set a bus driver, his bus and a truck on fire in Oboama Nguru (Ahiazu Mbaise, Imo) for violating a sit-at-home order. It is unclear whether the victim was killed.
On 1 October 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a pregnant woman and her child from a hospital in Damaturu (Damaturu, Yobe). A 2 million naira ransom has been demanded by the abductors.
On 1 October 2021, police forces of Nigeria clashed with a Zamfara communal militia at the Gummi axis (Gummi, Zamfara). Five militia members were killed, one leader of the militia was arrested.

Around 1 October 2021 (between 1 October - 2 October), a Niger militia abducted the permanent secretary in Niger's ministry of transportation, together with his son, at Zungeru (Wushishi, Niger). Other reports stated that his granddaughter (instead of son) was abducted. The abductors have demanded 30 million naira as ransom.

On 1 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked civilians in Emonoja (Olamaboro, Kogi), coded as Okpo; two people were abducted, one was wounded. The victims were rescued by police and a communal militia.
On 1 October 2021, a businessman was shot and killed by an unidentified armed group at his residence in Ibagwa-Ani (Nsukka, Enugu), coded as Nsukka.

On 1 October 2021, a member of an unidentified cult group struck a man with the butt of a knife at Ijegun (Alimosho, Lagos) and injured him for refusing to join his cult militia group. The victim escaped and ran into an estate.
On 1 October 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar shelling attack on a Nigerian army base in Bama (Bama, Borno), allegedly causing damages and injuries.

On 1 October 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a university professor (lecturer) travelling along the Akure - Ado-Ekiti Expressway, Ado Ekiti LGA (Ekiti). A ransom of 10 million naira was demanded from the victim's family. The victim was released on 6 October, there are no details whether a ransom was paid.

Around 1 October 2021 (as reported), some Aye Cult militia members stripped a woman naked and beat her up for using the cultists' songs in her TikTok Video in Benin City (Oredo, Edo). The police later arrested three of the cult members in September 2021.

On 1 October 2021, unidentified gunmen enforcing IPOB sit at home order killed a driver and set his vehicle ablaze along the Owerri-Umuahia road (Owerri Municipal, Imo). The other occupants of the vehicles fled.
On 1 October 2021, Nigerian troops clashed with ISWAP militants in the Gwoza-Bulabulin area (Gwoza, Borno), coded as Gwoza; three militants were killed, weapons and ammunitions were seized.
On 2 October 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with an unidentified number of armed men travelling in an SUV at Awkuzu (Oyi, Anambra). All the armed men were killed; fatalities coded as 3.

On 2 October 2021, Niger militiamen ambushed and clashed with military forces in the Madaka community, Shiroro LGA (Niger) [coded to Kuta]. 2 the security forces were killed and 13 were injured. An unspecified number of militiamen were injured.
Around 2 October 2021 (as reported), a Kaduna militia attacked and killed two residents in Ungwan Taila (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab.
On 2 October 2021, a Fulani pastoralist attacked and killed a man over a disagreement in Emene (Enugu East, Enugu).

On 2 October 2021, Nigerian troops engaged ISWAP militants in a clash and foiled an attack by the militants on a facility housing repentant militants in Damboa (Damboa, Borno). ISWAP claimed the abduction of one soldier, the destruction of a telecommunications tower and destruction of vehicles during the attack. Casualties unknown.

On 2 October 2021, a Zamfara communal militia attacked civilians along the Shinkafi-Kaura Namoda road (Shinkafi, Zamfara) coded as Shinkafi; a MSF nurse/aid worker and two other individuals were killed.
Around 2 October 2021 (as reported), Boko Haram and ISWAP militants clashed at Gwoza (Gwoza, Borno). 24 ISWAP militants were reportedly killed.
On 3 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a man and his three children along the Akure - Ado-Ekiti Expressway, Iju (Akure North, Ondo). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

Around 3 October 2021 (as reported), police forces engaged an unidentified armed group in a clash while trying to rescue individuals abducted by the group in the Kogi state. One of the victims died of a heart attack, the other was rescued. Location coded to Lokoja (Lokoja, Kogi).

On 3 October 2021, ISWAP militants claimed an attack with automatic weapons, killing 2 soldiers, and the detonations of two explosives on Nigeria troops on the road linking the towns of Dikwa and Ajiri (Dikwa, Borno). One vehicle belonging to the Nigeria troops was destroyed, the occupants were killed and wounded. Unknown fatalities among vehicle occupants coded as 3.

On 3 October 2021, suspected IPOB attacked and killed between two to three civilians in Nnewi (Nnewi North, Anambra). The operational office of the Department of State Services, the house of an APC member and FRSC office were also set ablaze.
On 3 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked civilians in Isara (Remo North, Ogun), five people were wounded by the assailants.
On 3 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked members of the Irigwe group in the Hukke village, Miango district (Bassa, Plateau), three people were killed and three others were wounded.

On 4 October 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted nine travelers at Okpella (Etsako West, Edo). The victims were abandoned by the abductors after policemen and a local defense militia went after them. The victims were rescued.
On 4 October 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with agents of the department of state services along Ukwu-Orji (Mbaitoli, Imo), coded as Eziama Obiato. One DSS agent was killed.
On 4 October 2021, unidentified armed men shot sporadically while enforcing a sit at home order in Owerri (Owerri Municipal, Imo). Casualties unknown. Police sources denied reports of the attack.

On 5 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked an office of the neighborhood watch group in Ogurute, Enugu-Ezike (Igbo Eze North, Enugu). Two members of the neighborhood watch group were killed and an unspecified number of people were injured, three patrol vehicles and the office were set ablaze.

On 5 October 2021, a Niger communal militia clashed with policemen during an attack on Pangu (Rafi, Niger), coded as Tegina. Five policemen were killed, buildings and vehicles were vandalized by the militias.
On 5 October 2021, a female student was abducted by unidentified armed men in Kano (Kano Municipal, Kano). The abductors have demanded for 100 million naira ransom.

On 5 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked civilians in Yasore (Batsari, Katsina), coded as Batsari; ten people were killed, eleven others were injured, indigenes claim 16 people were killed. The assailants rustled animals, looted and set scores of houses and food barns ablaze.

On 5 October 2021, unidentified cult militias clashed and shot 3 militiamen dead in Awka (Awka South, Anambra). Two of the victims were killed opposite First Market, Ifite, while the third was killed behind the Chukwuemeka Odumegwu Ojukwu Teaching Hospital, Amaku. 3 fatalities were reported.

On 5 October 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed between 18 to 19 people, including women and children, in Kurya Madaro (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara), coded as Kuriya. Some vehicles and shops were destroyed by the attackers.

Around 6 October 2021 (as reported), a communal militia in Kogi, together with hunters, clashed with an unidentified armed group around Koton-Karfe (Kogi, Kogi). Three victims abducted by the UAG were rescued by the militia. Casualties unknown.

On 6 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted four people, including a child and three farmers at Ilasa Ekiti (Ekiti East, Ekiti), coded as Omuo-Ekiti. Police sources claim two people were abducted and one had been rescued.
Around 6 October 2021 (as reported), police forces foiled an abduction attempt and clashed with an unidentified armed group at Agbor (Ika South, Delta). Three of the UAG members were killed.

On 6 October 2021, unidentified armed men killed a civil servant at a hotel in Agege (Agege, Lagos), the victim's phone and bag containing documents were stolen by the assailants. Reports indicate that the attack was targeted.
On 6 October 2021, Amotekun corps clashed with an unidentified armed group and rescued an abducted victim in Okitipupa (Okitipupa, Ondo). One member of the armed group was killed.

On 6 October 2021, ISWAP member stormed a Boko Haram camp in Lake Chad on 50 speed boats (location coded as Ngala, Borno) and reportedly killed more than 87 Boko Haram members in retaliation for the killing of 24 ISWAP members killed this week [coded separately].
On 6 October 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on the predominantly Christian town of Shikarkir (Chibok, Borno); three people were killed, churches were burnt, and a vehicle and motorcycles were seized.

On 6 October 2021, operatives of the DSS invaded the Ayope area of Owode Ede (Ede North, Osun), shot sporadically, killed a man and arrested 3 others. The operatives were called to intervene in a fight in the area.
On 6 October 2021, police forces clashed with IPOB militants in Umuakanu (Ehime Mbano, Imo), code as Umueze. One IPOB militant was killed.

On 7 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked civilians in Nkalagu (Ishielu, Ebonyi). Ten people were wounded, an unspecified number of buildings were vandalized, five motorcycles were set on fire.
On 7 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked and killed eight civilians in Onicha Igboeze (Onicha, Ebonyi), coded as Onicha.

On 7 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with unidentified armed men at a police checkpoint along the Orkija - Onitsha expressway (Ihiala, Anambra). One soldier and three armed men were killed, an unspecified number were wounded.
On 7 October 2021, two policemen were killed by unidentified armed men in Isu (Onicha, Ebonyi).
On 7 October 2021, Yansakai militiamen attacked civilians from Fulani settlements, killed eleven people and wounded four others in Mammande (Gwadabawa, Sokoto). The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 7 October 2021, the youth coordinator of NYCN in Odogbolu LGA was abducted along the Ogere axis (Ikenne, Ogun). The abductors have demanded a ransom of 30 million naira.
On 7 October 2021, a monarch and his wife were attacked by police officers in Aku (Igbo Etiti, Enugu). The monarch was taken to an undisclosed location by the police.
On 7 October 2021, ISWAP claimed a clash with Nigerian troops and CJTF militia in Mandafuma (Biu, Borno); according to the claim, one CJTF member was killed and the troops fled.

On 7 October 2021, police forces carried out an offensive attack on a Zamfara militia in the Tsibiri forest (Maradun, Zamfara), coded as Maradun. 187 abducted victims abducted from different parts of the state were rescued. Several militia members were arrested. There were no casualties.

On 7 October 2021, police forces rescued six abducted victims and engaged a Kaduna militia in a clash along the Barde/Keffi road (Jema'a, Kaduna), coded as Kafanchan. The militia members reportedly fled with gunshot wounds.
On 7 October 2021, policemen shot at a man in his car during a stop and search session in Benin City (Oredo, Edo). There were no casualties.
On 7 October 2021, remnants of the Shekau faction of Boko Haram attacked farmers around Gwoza (Gwoza, Borno). Casualties unknown.
On 8 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two persons in Lokoja (Lokoja, Kogi). There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 8 October 2021, suspected Fulani ethnic militia attacked civilians in a street market in Unguwar Lalle (Sabon Birni, Sokoto), killed at least 20 persons and wounded 35 others. An unspecified number of victims sustained life threatening injuries; wares were looted. The attack is reportedly a reprisal for the attack by Yansakai militia the previous day.

On 8 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked communities in Kabba (Kabba, Kogi), killed one chief, and abducted four other persons including a chief, a teacher and a Fulani man. The abductors have demanded for 30 million naira as collective ransom.

On 8 October 2021, soldiers attacked civilians in retaliation over a soldier that was killed by oil smugglers in Izombe (Oguta, Imo). Three individuals were killed, houses were burnt and the area was deserted.
On 8 October 2021, the military clashed with youths raiding the Izombe community (Oguta LGA, Imo). 3 people were killed, including 2 GSF. Two GSF patrol vehicles were also set on fire.
On 8 October 2021, policemen repelled an attack by unidentified armed men on a police station in the Aguobu-Owa community (Ezeagu, Enugu) coded as Ezeagu. One policeman was wounded.

On 9 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and beat up the legal adviser of the APC in Wakama ward (Nasarawa Eggon, Nassarawa), coded as Alogani. The attack was related to local government election held in the ward; the house of the victim's brother was burnt.

On 9 October 2021, armed men attacked the police divisional headquarters in Umulokpa (Uzo Uwani, Enugu). A female officer was abducted, operational vehicles were vandalized by the assailants. A police officer was injured.
On 9 October 2021, ISWAP claimed the abduction of an NGO worker at Nguma (Biu, Borno).
Around 10 October 2021 (as reported), officials of the Nigerian Customs shot and wounded a civilian in Fadi Gurje (Mani, Katsina), coded as Machika. The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 10 October 2021, Nigerian security and police forces clashed with a Zamfara militia fleeing Zamfara in Bangu Gari (Rafi, Niger), coded as Kagara. Five policemen and at least 32 militia men were killed, one was wounded.

On 10 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked a police station and clashed with policemen in Ngurore (Yola-North, Adamawa). A woman and her daughter were abducted from the area. There were no casualties. The abducted victims were rescued by the police around 12 October.
On 10 October 2021, a policeman shot and killed a civilian in Eket (Eket, Akwa Ibom). The victim was shot while he was trying to evade gunshots by police officers shooting at a ceremony.

On 10 October 2021, two unidentified cult groups clashed in Ijegun Egba (Amowo-Odofin, Lagos). They triggered panic forcing the residents to scamper for safety while hoodlums exploited the situation to dispossess the people of their valuables. No casualty was reported.

On 10 October 2021, Nigerian military forces repelled an attack by ISWAP [Lake Chad faction] in Aulari (Konduga, Borno). The military forces engaged ISWAP gun trucks with rockets; three gun trucks were burnt, one was immobilized. An unspecified number of ISWAP members were killed; unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 10 October 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on the CJTF militia in Bama (Bama, Borno), which led to the killing of four CJTF members while the rest fled.
On 10 October 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on Nigerian military patrol along the Dikwa-Gamboru road (Dikwa, Borno), coded as Dikwa. There were no casualties.
On 11 October 2021, a Baptist pastor and his friend, both farmers, were killed by a Fulani militia in Lisuru Gida (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Kigudu.
On 11 October 2021, an unidentified group attacked policemen in front of a police station and checkpoint along the Ogbia-Kolo road (Ogbia, Bayelsa). One policeman was seriously wounded.

On 11 October 2021, members of the CJTF assigned to a school in Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno) attacked and killed the head teacher of a school for disengaging their services due to alleged theft by the CJTF members.

On 11 October 2021, presumed ISWAP/Boko Haram clashed with military forces at the Molai-Polo axis in Maiduguri LGA (Borno) [coded to Maiduguri, Maiduguri Metro]. A farmer was killed by a stray bullet.

On 11 October 2021, a Kaduna militia clashed with local vigilantes during an attack to a seminary in Fadan Kagoma (Jema'a, Kaduna). Six seminarians were wounded, five were abducted and two were later released. The abductors demanded a ransom of 50 million naira, other reports claim 15 million. The abductees were released 48 hours later, no reports about whether a ransom was paid.
Around 11 October 2021 (as reported), a Benue militia attacked and killed a farmer in Rafinkada (Wukari, Taraba). The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 11 October 2021, unidentified armed men shot sporadically in the air to disperse people and enforce a sit at home order in Umuahia (Umuahia North, Abia). There were no casualties.
On 11 October 2021, armed men enforcing IPOB sit in order shot and killed a security guard of a hospital on his way home from work at Ozalla (Nkanu West, Enugu).

On 12 October 2021, a Niger communal militia clashed with a Shiroro communal militia and a group of hunters when the Niger militia invaded Farin Doki (Shiroro, Niger), coded as Farin Dutse. Two Shiroro militia members and scores (coded as 20) of the Niger militia men were killed. Fatalities coded as 22.

On 12 October 2021, an armed group from Ozoro attacked and killed 12 locals on their farmland in Oleh / Ole (Isoko South, Delta). The attack was over a lingering boundary dispute between the two communities; the Ozoro locals denied responsibility for the attack and claimed the farmland where the attack took place was not in dispute.

On 12 October 2021, Nigerian security forces repelled an attack by suspected IPOB on the convoy of the Anambra state governor at the rally of the APGA party in Ihiala (Ihiala, Anambra). One soldier was shot (condition not reported), at least six other people were killed and several others were injured.
On 12 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked the Divisional Police Station in Ogbia (Ogbia, Bayelsa). A police sergeant was killed and two rifles were stolen.
On 12 October 2021, the Bakura faction of Boko Haram attacked villagers around Bosso (Bosso, Borno), coded as Chanchaga. Casualties unknown.

On 12 October 2021, military forces of Nigeria foiled an attack by ISWAP/Boko Haram members on a camp in Ngamdu (Kaga, Borno). The attack was repelled by military helicopters and supported by ground troops; four soldiers were killed. Other sources report over six soldiers killed. Scores of ISWAP/BH members (coded as 20) were also killed and unspecified number were wounded.
On 12 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two university students in Calabar (Calabar Municipal, Cross River). A naval rating escaped the abduction.

On 12 October 2021, armed individuals, suspected NURTW members, attacked RTEAN workers at the Tin-Can First gate and Fagbems Gas station on the Apapa/Oshodi expressway (Apapa, Lagos), coded to Tin Can Island. 15 RTEAN workers were shot and injured. The attack is believed to follow RTEAN and NURTW clashes over ticket fees for truck drivers.
On 12 October 2021, officers of the Lagos task force shot and wounded a man who protested the bashing of his car by a commercial bus driver in Oshodi (Oshodi, Lagos).

On 13 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted some passengers travelling in Ibillo (Akoko Edo, Edo). The travelers were going to Makurdi from Lagos. There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.
On 13 October 2021, police officers shot and wounded a man during a stop and search operation in Odogbolu (Odogbolu, Ogun).

On 13 October 2021, a Zamfara militia ambushed Nigerian soldiers responding to a distress call between Kucheri and Wanzamai (Faskari, Katsina). Five soldiers were killed, and their rifles were stolen by the militia; an unspecified number of motorists were abducted.
On 13 October 2021, Boko Haram militants clashed with Nigerian troops in Metele (Guzamala, Borno), coded as Kukawa. Casualties unknown.

Around 13 October 2021 (as reported), a supremacy clash between Aye and Eiye cult militias led to the death of 3 people in Ibese and Owode (Ikorodu, Lagos), coded separately. The clash forced the people of the area to abandon their residences as they scampered for safety. Two casualties were cult members, while the third was a resident hit by stray bullets. 3 fatalities shared between the events. 1 casualty was reported.

Around 13 October 2021 (as reported), a supremacy clash between Aye and Eiye cult militias led to the death of 3 people in Owode and Ibese (Ikorodu, Lagos), coded separately. The clash forced the people of the areas to abandon their residents as they scampered for safety. Two of the casualties were cult members, while the third was a resident hit by stray bullets. 3 fatalities shared between the events. 2 casualties were reported.

On 13 October 2021, armed men abducted a catholic priest and woman from two different locations in Umuahia (Umuahia North, Abia). There are no reports about ransom demands yet; the priest was released on 24 October, there are no reports about whether a ransom was paid.

On 13 October 2021, suspected NURTW members clashed with RTEAN members over clashes regarding ticket fees for truck drivers at Mile two (Apapa, Lagos), coded as Apapa. Three RTEAN members were killed, an unspecified number of persons were wounded from both sides.
On 14 October 2021, a Zamfara communal militia attacked and killed twelve civilians in Sakajiki (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara). The assailants looted food items and destroyed several houses and shops.

On 14 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two children of a monarch and three domestic staff between Osi and Obo Aiyegunle (Ekiti, Kwara). The victims were rescued by the police around 18 October.

On 14 October 2021, armed men abducted a man along the Abaji-Toto road (Toto, Nassarawa), coded as Toto. The victim was a local militia member (assumed unarmed at this time). He was killed later in November after a ransom of 2 million naira was paid by his family [coded separately].
On 14 October 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack on a Nigerian military base in Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). Casualties unknown.

On 14 October 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on soldiers at a checkpoint in Tasmukawau (Kaga, Borno), coded as Ngamdu. Five soldiers were killed, two vehicles were taken by the militants and one was burnt.
On 14 October 2021, presumed ISWAP/Boko Haram clashed with military forces along the Gasarwa axis (Nganzai LGA, Borno). An unspecified number of GSF were killed; unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 14 October 2021, a Niger militia shot indiscriminately in Anguwar Juma'a (Suleja, Niger), coded as Suleja. Two persons were wounded, three others were abducted.

On 14 October 2021, a clash between Aye and Eiye cult militias left a girl dead in the Oja Oba area, Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The girl and her brother were hit by strayed bullets when some Aye members sporadically shot at a fleeing Eiye member in the market area. One casualty was recorded.
On 15 October 2021, a Kaduna militia shot and killed one person in Rugan Mati (Giwa, Kaduna), coded as Giwa.
On 15 October 2021, a Kaduna militia shot and killed one person at his residence in Kadage (Giwa, Kaduna).

Around 15 October 2021 (month of), unidentified armed individuals clashed with Karim Lamidu militia in the Karim Lamidu LGA (Taraba), coded as Kambari. Seven of the attackers were killed and their bodies were taken away by the group.
On 15 October 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack with four mortar shells on a Nigerian army base in Goniri (Gujba, Yobe). Casualties unknown.
On 15 October 2021, three farmers were killed by Fulani pastoralists in Nkiendonwro, Miango district (Bassa, Plateau). One other person was wounded by the group.

On 15 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and abducted two people in Banye (Charanchi, Katsina), the village head and a student. The victims were released on 10 November, an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom.
Around 16 October 2021 (as reported), a Fulani pastoralist attacked and wounded a farmer with a machete over an ongoing land dispute in Kaiama (Kai Ama, Kwara).

On 16 October 2021, two armed groups belonging to factions of the APC in Osun state clashed around the venue of a parallel congress held by The Osun Progressives in Oshogbo (Osogbo, Osun). Two people were wounded.
On 16 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a Fulani pastoralists settlement, wounded one person and abducted two others in Rubochi (Kuje, FCT).

On 16 October 2021, a faction of the APC in Ogun attacked APC members loyal to Ibikunle Amosun at Ake (Abeokuta North, Ogun). An unspecified number of persons were wounded, other sources report one killed and three wounded.
On 16 October 2021, DSS operatives sealed off the venue of a parallel APC congress and fired tear gas at the supporters of the politicians in Kano (Kano Municipal, Kano).
On 16 October 2021, Nigerian forces repelled an attack by ISWAP militants at Kumshe area in Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno); over seven militants were killed.
On 16 October 2021, presumed ISWAP/Boko Haram attacked a military position in Kumshe (Bama, Borno). 5 security forces members were killed and 1 vehicle was seized.
On 16 October 2021, presumed ISWAP/Boko Haram clashed with the military forces while trying to attack Ajalari (Maiduguri, Borno) [coded to Maiduguri, Maiduguri Metro]. Casualties unknown.

On 16 October 2021, an unidentified armed group invaded the federal university of Lafia and abducted four students, in Lafia (Lafia, Nassarawa). A ransom of 25 million naira has been demanded from the victims' families.

Around 16 October 2021 (as reported), militias from Agila and Mgbo clashed around the boundary between Benue and Ebonyi states, nine people from Benue have been declared missing, and one dead person was found Sunday morning. Location coded to Apa-Agila (Ado, Benue).

On 16 October 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with military forces during an attack on the PDP holding a parallel congress in Ibadan (Ibadan North West, Oyo). The GSF were deployed and fired shots to disperse the group. Five persons were wounded, over fifty vehicles were destroyed.
On 16 October 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked the Awha-Ndiagu community (Ezeagu, Enugu), coded as Ezeagu; one person was wounded in the attack.

On 16 October 2021, an unidentified armed group disrupted the congress of the PDP at the Tafawa Balewa Square, Lagos (Lagos Island). The gunshots started following disagreements over the delegates list of some local government areas. Casualties unknown.
On 17 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a man and a woman from different locations in Jalingo (Taraba), coded as Yelwa. There are no reports on ransom demands yet.

On 17 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Etim Ekpo LGA (Akwa Ibom), coded as Ikot Edet, and Ukanafun LGA (coded separately). Four people were killed; fatalities split across two events.

On 17 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Ukanafun LGA (Akwa Ibom), coded as Ukanafun, and Etim Ekpo LGA (coded separately). Four people were killed; fatalities split across two events.
On 17 October 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed a man outside of his church in Illorin (Ilorin East, Kwara). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 17 October 2021, unidentified armed men, presumably Sokota militias, attacked civilians at a market in Goronyo (Goronyo, Sokoto). At least 49 persons were killed and an unspecified number were injured.
On 17 October 2021, ISWAP claimed to have clashed with military forces in Ladari, a village close to Gambori (Nganzai, Borno). Casualties unknown.
On 17 October 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on a Nigerian army checkpoint in Tasmukawu, east of Ngamdu (Kaga, Borno). One soldier was killed, equipment belonging to the troops were seized.
On 17 October 2021, the Icelander and the Deebam cult militia clashed in Udianga Enem and Ikot Udobong village (Etim Ekpo, Akwa Ibom). There were 2 fatalities in the fighting.
On 17 October 2021, the Icelander and the Deebam cult groups clashed and killed a rival group member in Ikot Ibekwe (Ukanafun, Akwa Ibom). 1 fatality was reported.
On 17 October 2021, the Icelander militia clashed with the Deebam in a renewed cult crisis and killed a man in Ikot Una (Ukanafun, Akwa Ibom). 1 fatality was reported.

On 17 October 2021, an unidentified cult militia shot and killed a man in Ilorin (Ilorin West, Kwara). The cult militiamen called the man out of the Redeemed Christian Church of God while service was ongoing and shot him in the head. 1 fatality was reported.

On 17 October 2021, Agila communal militia members attacked and killed one person from the Mgbo ethnic group in retaliation of previous attacks (coded previously), in Apa ward of Ado Local Government Area of Benue State. Location coded as Apa-Agila (Ado, Benue). The local government chairman of Ado LGA announced a dusk to dawn curfew in the area following the attacks.

On 18 October 2021, security forces clashed with a Kaduna militia around the outskirts of Fatika (Giwa, Kaduna). One abductee was rescued, ten militia members were killed and several others escaped with gunshot wounds.
On 18 October 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked and killed a woman on her farm in Nimbo (Uzo Uwani, Enugu).
On 18 October 2021, a Katsina militia ambushed and killed three persons in Jarkuka (Jibia, Katsina), coded as Jibia.

On 18 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the police divisional headquarters in Ohaukwu (Ebonyi), coded as Ezamgbo. One policeman was shot and later died from gunshot wounds, some operational vehicles were set ablaze. Other sources report that the assailant freed up to 35 detainees in custody; the police have denied this report.

On 18 October 2021, Nigerian forces repelled an incursion by ISWAP at Chabbal, near Maiduguri - Magumeri - Gubio road, 3 km from Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno). Twenty militants were killed, multiple gun trucks and weapons were recovered by the troops.

On 18 October 2021, Nigeria and Cameroonian forces foiled an infiltration by Boko Haram/ISWAP militants into a military camp in Wulgo (Ngala, Borno). Four militants were killed, weapons and ammunitions were also seized by the troops. ISWAP claimed the attack with 10 soldiers killed and 8 wounded.

Around 18 October 2021 (as reported), two persons were abducted by a Niger militia in Suleja (Suleja, Niger). They were released on 24 October after a ransom of 1 million naira each was paid and call card worth 50 thousand was provided to their abductors.

On 18 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the convoy of a lawmaker along Akure -Okene road (Okene, Kogi), coded as Okene, and shot at his suspected sitting position. The lawmaker was not in the convoy, casualties unknown.
On 19 October 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a businessman in Igbo Aran (Asa, Kwara). There are no details about ransom demands.
On 19 October 2021, two soldiers tortured a man to death in Aboh (Ndokwa East, Delta) over robbery accusations.
On 19 October 2021, Nigerian troops killed over fifty Kaduna militia members during air raids supported by ground troops in the Saulawa - Farin-Ruwa axis (Birnin Gwari, Kaduna).

On 19 October 2021, suspected militia members abducted the brother in-law of a former governor of Zamfara and his neighbor in Talata Mafara (Talata Mafara, Zamfara). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

Around 19 October 2021 (as reported), twenty five persons were abducted by a Katsina militia in Kanon Haki (Faskari, Katsina), coded as Faskari. The victims were released on 1 November, no details about ransom payment provided.

On 19 October 2021, Al Barnawi's successor, Mallam Bako, alongside another ISWAP commander, were killed during an operation by military forces; this was confirmed by the National Security Adviser. Location coded to Maiduguri (Maiduguri Metro, Borno).

On 19 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked a traditional rulers' meeting at Nnenasa (Njaba, Imo); two rulers were killed, other sources reported three fatalities; 3 others sustained gunshots. The IPOB has denied links with the attack.

On 19 October 2021, Ebube Agu security operatives killed four persons and wounded an unspecified number of individuals in Amaseri (Afikpo North, Ebonyi). The victims were attacked because they allegedly sealed off a quarry company.

On 19 October 2021, a Zamfara militia abducted four persons believed to be students in Tsafe (Tsafe, Zamfara); the abductees were travelling to Kebbi from Benue. The abductors have demanded for 2 million naira each as ransom. The victims have been released, one escaped; reports do not mention whether a ransom was paid.

On 20 October 2021, an armed group opened fire and launched an explosive against a train on the Kaduna - Abuja railway, between Dutse and Kakau (Chikun, Kaduna). The group targeted the engine driver and the tank; the train was damaged. There were no casualties.

On 20 October 2021, Gungura and Buri-Buri militias clashed in a village in Gungura ward (Ganjuwa, Bauchi), coded as Ganjuwa. An unspecified number of people were killed and properties were destroyed. The police have debunked claims of fatalities from the clash. Fatalities unknown.

On 20 October 2021, a Niger militia or gunmen dressed in military uniform [coded as an unidentified armed group] abducted about thirty passengers traveling at Konar Barau village along Tegina - Minna Road or Garin-Gabas (Rafi, Niger), coded as Kagara. 13 of the victims were fishers.

On 20 October 2021, an unidentified cult group attacked a school and killed a female student in Ogume (Ndokwa West, Delta). They also assaulted the school administrator and burnt down numerous properties, including the administrative building, ICT centre and the school administrator's car.
On 20 October 2021, policemen attacked and beat up a nurse on duty in a hospital in Katsina (Katsina, Katsina). The nurse was attacked over his refusal to buy drugs for patients with his money.
On 20 October 2021, policemen attacked participants and conveners of an EndSARS symposium in Enugu (Enugu North, Enugu). The reason for the attack is unknown. There were no casualties.
On 20 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted 123 passengers around Ubiaja expressway (Esan South East, Edo). One passenger was rescued by a hunter.

On 21 October 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists abducted one person from a vehicle returning from Aba in Lokpanta (Nneochi, Abia). The victim was released n 26 October after a ransom of 2 million naira was paid.
On 21 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with IPOB militants enforcing a sit in order in Arochukwu (Arochukwu, Abia). At least four militants were killed.

On 21 October 2021, suspected IPOB militants set the palace of the traditional ruler of Etekuru (Ohaji, Imo) ablaze. The ruler, his wife and child managed to escape. Other sources report that the houses of a community leader and headmaster were also set ablaze.
On 21 October 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked Gabaken Mesa (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara), coded as Kaura Namoda, and killed one person. The attackers also rustled cattle in the attack.

On 21 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers attempted to foil an abduction attempt and clashed with an unidentified armed group in Ayebode (Ikole, Ekiti), coded as Ikole. Six persons were rescued, three were abducted. The victims were released on 24 October, police claims five victims were released.
On 21 October 2021, suspected IPOB militants attacked a police station in Umu Elemai (Isiala Mbano, Imo) with petrol bombs and engaged in a clash with policemen. One police officer was killed.

On 22 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a correctional facility in Oyo (Oyo West, Oyo). The assailants set all the inmates free, 446 out of 907 escapees have been rearrested, and between 2 -3 killed including a soldier and one Amotekun operative and some sources also indicate one inmate fatality.

On 22 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked the Abolongo Correctional Centre in Oyo town (Oyo West, Oyo). There were no fatalities. Some residents of the area also heard explosions outside of the Centre.
Around 22 October 2021, two persons were abducted by a Zamfara militia at Magami (Kaura Namoda, Zamfara), coded as Kaura Namoda. The victims were rescued by the police at Zurmi.

On 22 October 2021, two girls were abducted from the entrance of their home by unidentified armed men in Akure (Akure South, Ondo). The abductors demanded 40 million naira as ransom, 5 million was paid and the victims were released on 26 October.

On 23 October 2021, Nigerian military forces repelled an attack by ISWAP militants with support of an airstrike in Bujimirum (Gujba, Yobe). An unspecified number of militants were killed, three soldiers were wounded, unknown fatalities coded as 10. ISWAP claimed three soldiers were killed and weapons were seized.

On 24 October 2021, security forces engaged a Katsina militia in an armed clash at Megezoji (Dan-Musa, Katsina), coded as Dan Musa. Domestic animals were recovered from the militia's camp, casualties unknown.

On 24 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a Protestant church and abducted three Christians in Oba Oko (Ewekoro, Ogun), coded as Itori. The abductors have demanded for a ransom of 6 million naira.

On 24 October 2021, a Kogi militia foiled an attack on civilians by an unidentified group along Abuja-Lokoja road (Lokoja, Kogi), coded as Lokoja. The attackers reportedly fled when the militia on patrol shot into the air, the driver of the bus was wounded, other sources claims the attack was repelled by security forces.
Around 24 October 2021 (as reported), a Kaduna militia attacked and killed two persons in Ungwan Taila (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Zangon Katab.
On 24 October 2021, an unidentified group clashed with Fulani pastoralists in Agbudu (Kogi, Kogi), coded as Koton-Karfe. Two pastoralists and one of the assailants were killed.

On 24 October 2021, aiye and supreme vikings cult militias clashed in Ufuoma community (Ughelli North, Delta), coded as Ughelli. One person was wounded and arrested by policemen while the other militia members fled on sighting the police.

On 24 October 2021, security forces engaged a Katsina militia in an armed clash at Kadoji (Jibia, Katsina), coded as Jibia. Domestic animals were recovered from the militia's camp, casualties unknown.
On 24 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked civilians in Ungwan Samanja (Faskari, Katsina), coded as Faskari. At least six people were killed and an unspecified number were abducted.
On 24 October 2021, ISWAP militants ambushed and killed 17 Boko Haram militants including two commanders at Toumboun Gadura'a. Location coded as Tumbun Gini (Abadan, Borno).

On 24 October 2021, policemen repelled an attack by suspected IPOB militants at a police station in Unwana (Afikpo North, Ebonyi). Between 1-4 were killed, including policemen and gunmen. The police claim no officer was killed.

Around 24 October 2021 (as reported), military forces clashed with a Shiroro communal militia in Iburo (Shiroro, Niger), coded as Shiroro. Two sons of the Shiroro militia leader (also part of the militia) were killed by security forces during the clash, leading to the surrender of the militia leader to security forces.
On 25 October 2021, a Niger militia attacked and killed one person in Kabogi village (Mashegu, Niger).

On 25 October 2021, an unidentified armed group fired indiscriminately in a forest near a farm settlement in Uro Ajowa (Akoko North West, Ondo). The body of a farmer with machete cuts was found later.

On 25 October 2021, a Niger militia attacked worshippers in a mosque at Maza Kuka (Mashegu, Niger), coded as Daja. 16 persons were killed and 18 others were abducted. Other sources report 17 killed, the abductors demanded 60 million naira ransom for the abductees, the ransom was reduced to 200,000 and food items.
On 25 October 2021, a Niger militia attacked and killed a district head and his brother in a reprisal attack at Adogon Malam (Mashegu, Niger), coded as Mashegu.

On 25 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed six persons in Bugana (Omala, Kogi), the traditional ruler's palace was set ablaze. Reports suggest that the attack was a result of a clan/communal clash, other sources report the attack as a reprisal, hundreds of residents have fled to neighbouring communities.

Around 25 October 2021 (as reported), an unidentified armed group attacked the Paramount Ruler of Luuwa community in NyoKhana District, coded to Luwa (Khana, Rivers). He had been abducted by youths fighting over the position of youth president two years earlier, and the family had paid for his release twice. His decomposing body was found at a creek.
On 25 October 2021, a Niger militia abducted no fewer than ten persons from a community in Bassa (Shiroro, Niger). There are no reports about demand for ransom yet.
On 25 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked two teachers in Ijoun (Egbado North, Ogun). The assailants were reportedly hired by students of the school, there were no casualties.
On 25 October 2021, a Kaduna communal militia clashed with a militia of Fulani pastoralists in Jankasa (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna). Between 2 - 4 people were killed, three others were wounded.

On 25 October 2021, Russian Naval forces helped the Nigerian Navy repeled an attack by pirates on board a ship 70 nautical miles off the coast of Port Harcourt (Port Harcourt, Rivers). The Russians dispatched helicopters from their ship and the pirates fled. Casualties unknown.
On 25 October 2021, ISWAP claimed to have clashed with military forces and killed one Nigerian soldier in Kombi (Damboa, Borno). An SUV, weapons and ammunition were seized.

On 25 October 2021, Nigerian forces fired artillery projectiles towards Kote axis (Bama, Borno) following reports of a gathering of presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants on the outskirts of the area. Casualties unknown.

On 25 October 2021, at least six an unidentified armed group abducted 3 civilians from Lemma community Calabar (Calabar Municipal, Cross River). The assailants stole cash as well, there are no reports about demands for ransom yet.
On 25 October 2021, Nigerian forces fired artillery projectiles towards unidentified targets in the eastern outskirts of Buni Gari (Gujba, Yobe). Casualties unknown.

Around 25 October 2021 (as reported), a Kaduna militia attacked Fulani pastoralists in Manchok (Kaura, Kaduna). There were no casualties from the attack; cattle were killed and stolen by the assailants, the attack was a reprisal of an initial clash.
On 25 October 2021, armed men one of whom claimed to be a member of the OPC killed one person and wounded seven others in Igbo Oba community of Igbesa (Ado-Odo, Ogun).

On 25 October 2021, an unidentified armed group suspected to be land grabbers shot and injured six persons in Jegede community of Igbesa (Ado-Odo, Ogun) while attempting to take over their land. There were no fatalities.
On 25 October 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked Ganawuri (Riyom, Plateau), coded as Ganawuri Hills. Casualties unknown.

On 26 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted and killed a civilian in Abba (Nkwangele, Imo), coded as Amaigbo. The victim was killed by the assailants who suspected that the victim was a vigilante group member (assumed unarmed during the attack). They also abducted a woman and her son.

On 26 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted eight persons in Itapaji (Ikole, Ekiti); fourteen persons were initially abducted, six later escaped. The abductors have demanded a ransom of 50 million naira, the victims were released after 2.5 million naira, a pack of cigarette and a pack of milk were given to their abductors.

On 26 October 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed seven individuals in Yanbuki (Zurmi, Zamfara). The assailants conducted a house to house search for food items, rustled over 1500 domestic animals, wounded an unspecified number of persons while others are not yet found.

Around 26 October 2021 (as reported), a Zamfara militia and a Dansadau militia clashed over battle for supremacy between Chilin and Fammaje. Damina the leader of the Dansadau militia was wounded and died from his wounds, other sources claim he was attacked and dismembered later. Location coded as Dan Sadau (Maru, Zamfara).

On 26 October 2021, the military forces attacked in Amangwu (Ohafia, Abia). Casualties were reported by villagers and houses burnt. The army spokesperson denies any deaths or burnt houses. The military were searching for stockpile of weapons. No weapons or persons stockpiling them were found. Casualties unkown
Around 27 October 2021 (as reported), armed men loyal to a leader of the APC attacked supporters of another APC leader in Idah (Idah, Kogi), one of the victims is in a critical condition.
On 27 October 2021, a farmer was killed by an unidentified armed group on his farm in Dobi (Gwagwalada, FCT).

Around 27 October 2021 (as reported), an unidentified armed group attacked a young man on Okwele Road, coded to Okwele (Isiala Mbano, Imo). He was killed in the attack. The reason for the attack is not known.

On 27 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two men along Akwakuma road (Owerri North, Imo), coded as Orji. The victims were freed after their abductors fled following a chase by the police [no clash reported].
On 28 October 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and killed four persons in Gurbin Baure (Zurmi, Zamfara). An unspecified number of persons were injured and several animals were rustled.
On 28 October 2021, unidentified armed men attempted to abduct two teachers in Osi (Ekiti, Kwara). One of the victims was wounded, the abduction attempt was unsuccessful.
On 28 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and killed five residents in Dangeza (Batsari, Katsina), coded to Batsari. Scores of individuals were wounded.

On 28 October 2021, suspected ISWAP militants clashed with military forces in Damboa (Damboa, Borno). Four persons including three policemen were killed, other sources report a dozen civilians and two policemen killed while the police office and three operational vehicles were set ablaze.
Around 28 October 2021 (as reported), ISWAP militants clashed with Nigerian soldiers in Kwada (Chibok, Borno), civilians were also attacked by the militants. Casualties unknown.
On 28 October 2021, soldiers repelled an attack on the convoy of the Borno state governor by suspected ISWAP militants around Malam Fatori (Abadan, Borno). Casualties unknown.

On 28 October 2021, presumed Boko Haram/ ISWAP militants clashed with military forces of Nigeria at Rann (Kala Balge, Borno). 4 militants were killed, 2 soldiers were wounded, weapons and ammunitions were recovered.

On 28 October 2021, Nigeria military forces clashed with Biafran National Guard militants in Amaekpu (Ohafia, Abia), coded as Ohafia. One BNG assailant was killed, weapons were recovered by the troops while the rest of the assailants fled and were intercepted at Ohaozara, Ebonyi.
On 28 October 2021, suspected IPOB militants killed three truck drivers and set their bodies ablaze in Orsu, coded as Afozuru (Imo).

On 28 October 2021, five people were killed in a clash between Owahwa and Okwagbe militias in one of the two areas (Ughelli South, Delta), coded as Okwagbe. Sources claim the clash is as a result of boundary dispute between the both communities.

On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men abducted the chief imam of Yangoji central mosque, together with two of his sons, in Yangoji (Kwali, FCT). The abductors have demanded a ransom of 10 million naira.
On 29 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Igbomoturu (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa), coded as Ezeotu. One person was killed, three others were injured and two went missing.

On 29 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers raided ESN (IPOB) camps and clashed with the militants in Ochokwu (Ikwo, Ebonyi). Some militants were killed, weapons and ammunition were recovered by the soldiers. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.
On 29 October 2021, Nigerian soldiers clashed with IPOB militants and killed four of them at Nnobi (Idemili South, Anambra). The militants were fleeing a clash with security agents at Ekwulobia.
On 29 October 2021, an Ijaw pastor from Ogbe-Ijoh was attacked by an Aladja militia in Aladja (Warri South, Delta). The victim died a few days later from injuries he sustained in the attack.
On 29 October 2021, a member of the Agbarho communal militia shot and killed a football player in Agbarho (Ughelli North, Delta). He was shot for trespassing into the palace of the Agbarho monarch.

Around 29 October 2021, ISWAP militants flogged 76 farmers abucted from an IDP camp in Ngala (Ngala, Borno) on 29 October. They were accused of collaborating with Nigerian soldiers. They were released on 31 October.
On 29 October 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted 9 people in Danglimi (Kachia, Kaduna), coded as Kachia.
On 29 October 2021, an unidentified armed group attacked Igbomoturu (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa). One person was killed, three others were injured and two were missing.
On 29 October 2021, a Zamfara militia clashed with security agents in Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara). At least 20 were killed, around 19 police and 1 civilian.

On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men ambushed a convoy with DSS operatives in Ekwulobia (Aguata, Anambra). Two DSS operatives and 1 civilian were killed, other sources report several persons also wounded.
On 29 October 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed a man on his way from the airport in Owerri (Owerri Municipal, Imo). The reason for the attack is unknown.

On 30 October 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with security personnel at a construction site along Igbeddi/Amasomma road (Sagbama, Bayelsa), coded as Sagbama. One of the assailants was killed and an expatriate engineer was abducted.

On 30 October 2021, navy operatives engaged an unidentified armed group in an armed clash along the Ogonibiri waterways (Southern Ijaw, Bayelsa), coded as Olugbobiri. An expatriate that was abducted on the same day (coded separately) was rescued, and the abductors escaped with varying degrees of injuries.
On 30 October 2021, suspected Fulani militia abducted an unspecified number of travelers along the Sapele-Warri road (Sapele, Delta), coded as Sapele.

On 30 October 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and killed an unidentified number of civilians in Ungwan Dudu (Faskari, Katsina), coded as Faskari. The group looted shops during the attack and wounded an unspecified number of individuals. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 30 October 2021, Nigerian forces fired artillery against ISWAP/Boko Haram positions about six kilometers South West of Bama (Borno), coded as Bama. The gun trucks of the militants were neutralized. Casualties unknown.

On 30 October 2021, unidentified armed men attacked the home of the leader of the Ilana Omo Oodua group in Ado-Ekiti (Ado Ekiti, Ekiti). The assailants fired gunshots into the air. There were no casualties from the attack.
On 31 October 2021, a man was killed by a Kaduna militia in Barebari (Igabi, Kaduna), coded as Bina.

Around 31 October 2021 (as reported), Dogo Gide, the leader of a Zamfara militia was killed in his hideout by some members of his group and a Dansadau militia. He was being treated for gunshot injuries sustained in a battle in Kwiambana Forest Reserve (Maru, Zamfara); other sources have refuted claims of his death.

On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked worshippers at a Baptist church in Kakkau Daji (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Kakau. One worshipper was killed, other sources reported two; one was wounded, and 66 persons were abducted. The abductors have demanded food stuff to feed the abducted victims and a ransom of 99 million naira, two victims were killed and three others were injured by their captors on 6 November (coded separately). The victims were released around 4 December after an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom, the remaining 15 victims were released around 15 December, there are no details on ransom payment.
On 31 October 2021, soldiers foiled the attempted abduction of a catholic bishop by an unidentified armed group in Orlu (Orlu, Imo).
On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia killed two men in Sauran Giwa (Igabi, Kaduna). The victims were returning from a religious function when they were attacked.

Around 31 October 2021 (as reported), military forces of Nigeria foiled an attack by a Zamfara militia in Pan Dongari (Rafi, Niger). The troops received reinforcement from local militias of Kagara and Birinin Gwari villages. Causalities unknown.
On 31 October 2021, a Kaduna militia attacked and killed one local in the Kangon Kadi general area (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Chikun.

On 1 September 2021, a communal militia abducted 73 students in Kaya (Maradun, Zamfara); five students were reported to have escaped. All the abducted students were released, no further details whether ransom was paid provided.

On 1 September 2021, Zamfara militiamen abducted ten persons from Zurmi (Zurmi, Zamfara) after a failed attempt to attack the local government headquarters. Two of the abductees escaped; an initial ransom of 50 million was reduced to six million. The remaining 8 victims were killed around 3 March 2022 over the inability of their families to pay the ransom.
On 1 September 2021, a Katsina militia attacked and killed three people and abducted three others in Sabuwa LGA (Katsina), coded to Sabuwa.

Around 1 September 2021 (as reported), unidentified armed men abducted seven members of the same family in Pegi (Abuja Municipal, FCT), coded as Kuje. The victims were released on 25 September alongside other abductees, reports do not mention whether a ransom was paid.

On 1 September 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack on Nigerian troops that led to an armed clash in Mairami (Konduga, Borno). One soldier was killed and several injured, two bulldozers and a tank carrier were burnt.

Around 1 September 2021 (as reported), ISWAP militants attacked IDPs who left their camp in Bama (Bama, Borno) to neighboring Sabasawa. Out of the one hundred and seventy-seven IDPs, eleven returned, forty-eight were reportedly killed and one hundred and eighteen persons are unaccounted for. The victims reportedly left their camp to find other means of income.
On 1 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and shot at three lawmakers from Nassarawa state along Lafia-Akwanga (Lafia, Nassarawa) coded to Lafia. No fatalities were reported in the attack.
Around 1 September 2021 (as reported), a female student was shot and killed by unidentified armed men in Bori (Khana, Rivers). The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 1 September 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked and abducted an unspecified number of commuters along Kucere-Wamzamai-Tsafe (Tsafe, Zamfara) coded as Tsafe.

On 2 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted an unspecified number of children and armed relatives of the Katsina secretary to the state government in Daftau (Dan-Musa, Katsina), code as Dunya. The brother of the SSG was released, the family claims no ransom was paid.

On 2 September 2021, joint task force of Nigerian security forces engaged in an armed clash with armed militias in Bassa (Shiroro, Niger). 47 militia members were killed, an unspecified number escaped with gunshot wounds.

On 2 September 2021, military forces of Nigeria engaged in an armed clash with ISWAP militants along Damboa-Bulabulin-Maiduguri road, Kukawa (Kukawa, Borno) coded as Baga. Six militants were killed and ammunition was recovered.
Around 2 September 2021 (as reported), two ISWAP militants were killed by Nigerian military forces and CJTF during an armed clash at Musari village, (Ngala, Borno) coded as Gamboru.
On 2 September 2021, ISWAP/BH militants engaged in an armed clash with military forces of Nigeria in Malari (Guzamala, Borno). Six militants and three soldiers were killed.
On 2 September 2021, presumed ISWAP/Boko Haram clashed with presumed military forces in Mairari (Guzamala, Borno). 9 people (6 militiamen and 3 security forces members) were killed.
On 2 September 2021, police forces of Nigeria engaged in an armed clash with bandits which led to four bandits being killed in Dogon Fadama (Kontagora, Niger) coded as Kontagora.
Around 2 September 2021, militiamen attacked civilians in the village of Gago, coded to Dutsin Ma (Dutsinma, Katsina). Casualties unknown.
On 2 September 2021, police forces of Nigeria engaged in an armed clash with an unidentified armed group in Makurdi (Makurdi, Benue). An abducted victim was rescued by the police.
On 3 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted two persons from Yangoji (Kwali, FCT). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 3 September 2021, a Niger militia attacked and killed at least 20 civilians in Magami (Shiroro, Niger), coded as Kuta. The attack is reported to be a reprisal of the offensive carried out by the JTF against armed groups in the area on 1 September.
On 3 September 2021, armed militia attacked a police station and killed one police man in Bungudu (Bungudu, Zamfara). The assailants carted away with rifles .

On 3 September 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked a police station and clashed with police officers and a local militia in Nahuce and Gidan Jabula (Bungudu, Zamfara), coded as Gidan Babagoji. Between 2 and 3 people were killed and four others were abducted.
On 3 September 2021, armed militias attacked, killed four persons and abducted fifty others in Ruwan Doruwa (Maru, Zamfara) coded as Ruwan-Tofa.

On 3 September 2021, an unidentified armed group clashed with a local militia in Mararaba Pushit (Mangu LGA, Plateau), coded to Mangu, during a kidnap attack; one person was abducted in the attack. 2 local vigilantes were killed and 3 were injured.
On 3 September 2021, Yansakai clashed against the Gudde Turji group in Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara). Two the Gudde Turji were killed by Yansakai.
On 4 September 2021, factions of the APC clashed with guns over support for different candidates in Lapai (Lapai, Niger), coded to Saminaka.

On 4 September 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a reverend sister and four others at Isuwa (Ovia North East, Edo), coded as Okada. The reverend sister was rescued by the police; manner of rescue was not reported.

Around 4 September 2021 (as reported), the police shot and killed two cultist militants in Ibaa (Emohua, Rivers). The militants exchanged gunshots with the police to escape arrest but were fatally shot and later died in the hospital. 2 casualty was reported.

On 4 September 2021, a former female chief judge of Abia state and Chancellor of an Anglican Diocese in Imo State was abducted by an unidentified armed group in Orlu LGA (Imo), coded to Orlu, on her way to the Anambra state. There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 4 September 2021, an unidentified armed group opened fire against commuters along the Lagos - Benin Expressway by the Isiuwa junction (Ovia North East, Edo), coded as Okada. The brother of a human rights activist was killed and 5 people were abducted.

On 4 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a traditional title holder and engaged police officers who tried to rescue the victim in an armed clash at Taura (Taura, Jigawa). A police van was burnt by the group.

On 4 September 2021, armed individuals (described as bandits, coded as UAG) abducted the district head of Wawa in Wawa (Borgu, Niger). The victim was released on 20 October, and an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom.

On 4 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed a lecturer in his home along Dass road in Bauchi (Bauchi, Bauchi). One other person was injured in the attack. The reason for the attack was not reported.

On 4 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a woman and two of her daughters in Kuje (Abuja Municipal, FCT). The abductors have demanded for 50 million naira ransom. One of the victims was released after an undisclosed amount was paid, the other two victims were rescued by the police.
On 4 September 2021, a soldier opened fire while trying to disperse a crowd during local elections in Gwanki (Makarfi LGA, Kaduna). A girl was killed by a stray bullet.
On 4 September 2021, armed militias attacked, wounded one person and abducted three others in Kurami (Bakori, Katsina), coded as Bakori. There are no reports for ransom demands yet.
On 5 September 2021, an unidentified armed group engaged police and NSCDC officers in an armed clash that led to the killing of two officers in Yenagoa (Yenagoa, Bayelsa).
On 5 September 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted the 70-year-old father of Ogbia Local Government Chairman at Kpansia in Yenagoa (Yenagoa, Bayelsa)
On 5 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a man in Kpansia (Yenagoa, Bayelsa), coded to Ogu. The victim was released around 2 October, there are no reports about ransom payment.
On 5 September 2021, armed militias attacked and killed three people in Mahuta B (Dandume, Katsina). Two people were killed instantly, the third person died of bullet wounds the following day.

On 5 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked, wounded eight persons and abducted a former senator along the Oron road (Uyo, Akwa Ibom), coded as Uyo. The kidnappers demanded 200 million naira ransom for the abductee to be released. The victim was released after 54 days in captivity, there are no details about whether a ransom was paid.

On 5 September 2021, an armed militia and vigilantes engaged in an armed clash in Tafoki (Faskari, Katsina) after the armed militia abducted two sisters of the Deputy Speaker of the Katsina State House of Assembly. One of the women was rescued, the second victim escaped around 11 December during a raid on the abductors' hideout by the military.Casualties are unknown.

On 5 September 2021, a Fulani herder was killed by suspected members of Irigwe ethnic militia in a community in Miango (Bassa, Plateau). Irigwe ethnic group denied the allegation made by MACBAN about their involvement in the killing.
On 6 September 2021, armed militias abducted four children belonging to the village head at Sabuwar Kasa (Kafur, Katsina). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.
On 6 September 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists abducted an unspecified number of farmers on a farm at Oko-Irese (Irepodun, Kwara), coded as Esie. There are no reports on ransom demands yet.

On 6 September 2021, a local self-defense militia clashed with a Katsina militia after the militia abducted five people in Bakori (Bakori, Katsina). Three of the abductees were rescued, the group demanded a ransom of 70 million naira for the remaining two abducted victims; one more victim was released around 17 September, the last victim was released around 5 October, no reports regarding whether ransom was paid.

On 6 September 2021, a Katsina militia abducted three people, including the 2 sons of the Deputy Provost of a college, around Dutsin Ma (Dutsinma, Katsina). There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.
On 6 September 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted a man in Zango (Miga, Jigawa), coded as Miga. There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 6 September 2021, suspected Fulani militias killed two members of Irigwe ethnic group in a community in Miango (Bassa, Plateau). The attack is reportedly a reprisal over the killing of a pastoralist; other reports stated that three farmers were killed.

On 7 September 2021, armed militias abducted twenty people in Dange-Shuni (Dange-Shuni, Sokoto), coded as Boda. The militias are reported to be fleeing offensives by Nigerian troops in Zamfara, no reports for ransom demands yet.
Around 7 September 2021 (as reported), armed militias engaged with local militia members in an armed clash that killed two vigilantes at Mayaki (Lapai, Niger).

On 7 September 2021, militiamen clashed with a local vigilante group in Unguwar Yako, along the Kaduna - Birnin Gwari Highway (Birnin Gwari LGA, Kaduna). 5 the local group were killed and their vehicle was set on fire.
On 7 September 2021, officials of the Nigerian Customs Service shot and killed a man in Ibara-Orile (Abeokuta North, Ogun) while they were extorting motorcyclists in the area.
On 7 September 2021, armed militias ambushed local vigilantes, killed five and injured one in Udawa (Chikun, Kaduna).
On 7 September 2021, armed militias killed a policeman (assumed off-duty) in his home and abducted seven other persons in Ungwan Laka (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Rido.
On 7 September 2021, armed militias abducted sixteen people including women and children in Ungwan Maje (Chikun, Kaduna), coded to Romi. There are no reports about ransom demands yet.

On 7 September 2021, ISWAP claimed an armed clash against joint forces of Nigerian and Nigerien patrol troops in Gashigar (Mobbar, Borno). Two vehicles belonging to the troops were damaged, those inside were injured and the rest fled.
On 7 September 2021, officials of the Nigerian Customs shot at the convoy of a commissioner in Katsina state along Daura-Mai'adua (Daura, Katsina state). No reported injuries or fatalities.
On 7 September 2021, armed militia abducted eighteen people from Keke community (Chikun, Kaduna), coded to Chikun. There are no reports for ransom demands yet.
On 8 September 2021, the sister of a journalist was killed by an unidentified armed group in Enuagu Onicha Igboeze (Onicha LGA, Ebonyi).
On 8 September 2021, armed militias shot and killed a policeman during an attack on Juji (Chikun, Kaduna).
Around 8 September 2021 (as reported), armed militias abducted five women from Birnin Yero (Igabi, Kaduna). There are no reports about demands for ransom yet.

On 8 September 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted three workers in Kobape (Obafemi, Ogun). Varying reports say four workers were abducted. The workers have been released, police sources claim no ransom was paid.
On 8 September 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists abducted a retired university teacher along the Masayi - Isaga road, Yewa North LGA (Ogun) [coded to Isuku].
On 8 September 2021, an unidentified armed group shot and killed three policemen at a checkpoint in (Ukwuani, Delta), coded as Umutu. The reason for the attack is unknown.
On 8 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a man along the Isaga axis while he was travelling to Abeokuta (Abeokuta South, Ogun). The victim was rescued by hunters.

On 8 September 2021, unidentified gunmen abducted twelve travelers along the Ifira-Akoko/Idoani road (coded to Ikare, Akoko North East, Ondo). Amotekun corps rescued nine of the victims; the abductors demanded 10 million naira ransom for the remaining three victims, they were rescued around 11 September by Amotekun operatives, no details about ransom payment provided.

Around 8 September 2021 (week of), an unidentified cult militia shot and killed a youth at Iloro quarters, Owo (Owo, Ondo), in a mistaken identity. He was mistaken for a member of a rival cut militia and shot dead. The killing provoked a protest in the community. 1 fatality was reported.
Around 8 September 2021 (as reported), military and police forces engaged with militias in an armed clash in Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara). One militia member was severely wounded.

On 9 September 2021, Niger militiamen abducted no fewer than 34 persons, including traders, while they were returning from Kagara market (Rafi, Niger). The victims were released around 7 December; there are no reports about ransom payment.
On 9 September 2021, militiamen opened fire at Lambar Tureta (Tureta LGA, Sokoto). At least 6 people were killed and an unspecified number of people were injured and abducted.

On 9 September 2021, gunmen engaged police officers in an armed clash that led to the killing of three police officers and the abduction of an unspecified number of expatriates in Akukutoru LGA (Rivers) coded as Abonnema. The abducted expatriates were released around 4 October.

On 9 September 2021, an armed group clashed against soldiers attached to an expatriate group in transit from Degema LGA (Rivers) to Port Harcourt [coded to Degema]. 3 soldiers were shot and injured; a Lebanese expatriate was abducted. The group works for a construction company.
On 9 September 2021, armed militias attacked the Tsallake dogo community in Rigacikun (Igabi, Kaduna), shooting sporadically and kidnapping two people. There are no reports on ransom demands yet.
On 9 September 2021, unidentified gunmen attacked Fulani pastoralists and injured twenty-three persons in Waren camp (Riyom, Plateau) coded as Riyom. Ten cattle were killed in the attack.
On 10 September 2021, an armed group killed the former Igwe (traditional leader) of Mkpunado Aguleri and his driver in the Otuocha community (Anambra East, Anambra).
On 10 September 2021, soldiers beat a taxi driver and killed him over violation of the curfew in Farin Gada (Jos North, Plateau) coded to Jos.
On 10 September 2021, a policeman killed a civilian woman at her mother's shop during a raid in Surulere (Mushin, Lagos).

Around 11 September 2021, a pastor was attacked and killed with a machete by unidentifed individuals in Kibori (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna). The reason for the attack is unknown. The pastor's body was found on 12 September.

On 11 September 2021, police forces of Nigeria engaged IPOB militants in an armed clash in Amaifeke (Orlu, Imo) coded to Amike; three militants were killed, two were arrested and an unspecified number escaped with gunshot wounds.
On 11 September 2021, a Zamfara militias attacked a security forces base in Dan Sadau (Maru, Zamfara). Twelve security personnel, including military and police officers, were killed.
Around 11 September 2021, a police officer beat up a woman during an altercation at a police checkpoint in Obeagu (Agwu, Enugu).
On 11 September 2021, an APC agent was wounded by an unidentified armed group in Ole (Isoko South, Delta).
On 11 September 2021, an unidentified armed group shot and killed a man at an INEC polling unit in Irri (Isoko South, Delta). 1 fatality was reported

On 11 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked a border community between Taraba and Benue states; one person was killed and an unspecified number of people were abducted, residents of the community fled to Koffi Ahmadu (Takum, Taraba state). Location coded to Takum.

On 11 September 2021, police forces of Nigeria engaged an unidentified armed group in an armed clash at Ute Forest (coded to Benin City, Oredo, Edo). Five abducted victims were rescued, ammunitions were seized and two suspects were arrested.

Around 12 September 2021 (as reported), armed militias from Zamfara and Katsina states clashed with Nigerian troops in Maganda (Shiroro, Niger). One soldier and 42 militia members were killed. The militia members were fleeing from ongoing military operations in their states.

On 12 September 2021, suspected Fulani pastoralists attacked and killed twelve farmers in the Apiye Jim community, in the Atyap chiefdom, and another person in the Atakshusho village, both in Zangon Kataf, Kaduna (coded to Zangon Katab). An unspecified number of people were also reported missing.
Around 12 September 2021 (as reported), militia members attacked and killed a police officer along Dan Sadau-Gusau road (Maru, Zamfara), coded as Dan Sadau.

On 12 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked and killed two soldiers and one police officer guarding a prison, releasing two hundred and forty prisoners at a medium security prison in Kabba (Kabba, Kogi). About one hundred and eight inmates were rearrested, an unspecified number returned voluntarily while two prison guards are missing.

Around 13 September 2021, armed militia members fleeing Zamfara and Katsina states attacked Iburo (Shiroro, Niger) coded as Ibu. The group shot and injured a man and abducted two women. The militia members were fleeing from ongoing militiary operations in their states.
On 13 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a PDP politician and his driver in Obadan (Uhunmwode, Edo). There are no reports about ransom demands yet.
On 13 September 2021, an unidentified armed group abducted four travelers along the Ayetoro Ekiti - Otun Ekiti road (Moba, Ekiti). There are no reports regarding demands for ransom yet.

On 13 September 2021, a Kaduna militia abducted a catholic priest in Anchuna village (Zangon Kataf, Kaduna), coded as Gora. The victim was released on 15 September, reports do not indicate whether a ransom was paid.

On 13 September 2021, militia members clashed with Nigerian soldiers, police officers and members of a local militia in a community in Zaria LGA (Zaria, Kaduna). The group of around 30 people attacked the community, invading the house of a Kaduna State University lecturer, abducting a woman and eight children. During the shoot-out, a soldier was killed. Six children were rescued.

Around 13 September 2021 (as reported), a member of an unidentified cult militia engaged in a firefight with the police in Osogbo (Oshogbo, Osun) when the police attempted to raid their hideout. He sustained a gun wound and was taken to the hospital for treatment.

Around 13 September 2021 (as reported), an unidentified cult group hacked a member of a rival cult militia to death in Osogbo (Oshogbo, Osun). No further details were provided, but the police evacuated the body of the victims of the attack. 1 casualty reported.
On 14 September 2021, unknown gunmen and Gegu-Beki militia engaged in an armed clash at Gegu (Kogi, Kogi); the militia commander was killed, while some of the assailants escaped with gunshot wounds.

On 14 September 2021, militia members attacked a community in Maraban Rido (Chikun, Kaduna) coded as Kujama; one person was killed and five others were abducted. There are no reports on ransom demands for the abductees yet.
On 14 September 2021, a Sokoto miltia killed one civilian and abducted nine others in Wababi (Dange-Shuni, Sokoto).
On 14 September 2021, ISWAP claimed a mortar attack on a Nigerian army camp in Damboa (Damboa, Borno). Damages and injuries (unspecified) resulted from the attack.

On 14 September 2021, unidentified armed men killed an Anglican priest for inviting soldiers to guard a school in Iheteukwa (Orsu, Imo) coded as Awo-Idemili. IPOB has denied responsibility for the killing.
On 14 September 2021, ISWAP claimed an attack against Nigerian troops using automatic weapons that led to the killing of two soldiers in Buni Yadi (Gujba, Yobe). The rest of the troops fled.

On 14 September 2021, Fulani pastoralists clashed with a police escort along the Kaduna-Abuja road (Chikun, Kaduna), coded as Gwagwada. The police officer was killed, two other people were wounded and an unspecified number of people, including the emir of Bungundu emirate, were abducted. The Emir was released after 32 days in captivity; according to the Emir, his captors were Fulani pastoralists.

On 15 September 2021, a medical doctor was abducted and another person was shot and wounded by unidentified armed men in Ekparakwa (Oruk Anam, Akwa Ibom). The abducted person was released on 27 September after an undisclosed amount was paid as ransom.
On 15 September 2021, unidentified armed men abducted a woman at Nkpelu (Obio, Rivers). There are no reports for ransom demands yet.

On 15 September 2021, ISWAP militants engaged Nigerian troops in an armed clash at Burimari (Nganzai, Borno) coded as Gajiram. Six soldiers were killed. The soldiers were reportedly on patrol in the area.

Around 15 September 2021 (month of), unidentified armed men attacked a retired army captain at his residence in Agbonchia (Eleme, Rivers). He was shot in the leg and abducted by the assailants and later killed. The victim's corpse was exhumed from a shallow grave by the police in Igbo-Etche on 9 October. They claim to have arrested the suspects.

On 15 September 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed one person and abducted three people in Egbeda Kabba (Kabba, Kogi) coded as Kabba. Two of the abductees are poultry farmers; the abductors have demanded a ransom of 15 million naira.

On 15 September 2021, police officers engaged a Katsina militia in an armed clash at Kitibawa (Dutsinma, Katsina), coded as Dutsin Ma, as the group attacked the village killing two civilians and abducting 18 women and 10 babies. The police claimed to have rescued 10 victims.
On 15 September 2021, a Zamfara militia attacked civilians along Shinkafi - Gusau Road in Shinkafi LGA (Zamfara). A female staff of an international NGO was abducted.

On 16 September 2021, unidentified armed men shot and killed a lawyer at Amaifeke (Orlu, Imo) coded as Orlu. The victim was reportedly the lawyer to some of the persons arrested in connection to the violence in the area recently.

Around 16 September 2021 (as reported), military forces clashed with militia members fleeing from Zamfara state in Maiha (Maiha, Adamawa). Some militia members were killed by the soldiers, eleven rocket launchers and three grenades were recovered. Unknown fatalities coded as 10.
On 16 September 2021, Ekuigbo and Iwhreko communal militias clashed in Ughelli (Ughelli North, Delta), one person was killed and an unspecified number of people were injured.
Around 16 September 2021 (as reported), armed militia members attacked civilians in Shinkafi (Shinkafi, Zamfara); seven people were killed in seven days, the group also burnt houses in the attacks.

On 16 September 2021, security forces clashed with militia members in Karasami, along the Kaduna-Abuja road (Chikun, Kaduna) coded as Chikun. During the clash, one milita member and two civilians were killed.
On 17 September 2021, unidentified armed men attacked pastoralists in the Uchukku / Achiku village, Shanga LGA (Kebbi) [coded to Shanga]. Five people were killed and five were injured.
On 17 September 2021, a Kaduna Communal militia attacked Kadage (Giwa, Kaduna) and killed one person.
